metadata.title: Stocks to Watch: SoftBank, Nvidia, CoreWeave

content.text:
LIVE
4 hours ago
Stocks to Watch: SoftBank, Nvidia, CoreWeave
🔎SoftBank (JP:9984): The tech investor reported a $7 billion net loss after markets closed in Japan. Its shares jumped 14% before the close as AI-adjacent stocks rebounded.
🔎Nvidia (NVDA): Shares of the chip giant are flat premarket after yesterday’s slide, as investors continue to digest the impact of an investigation into whether CEO Jensen Huang was a spying target of China.
🔎 CoreWeave (CRWV): The Nvidia-backed cloud computing company is set to report quarterly results after the bell. Analysts expect revenue to grow but losses to widen.
